sloka: भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चैव शत्रुघ्नश्च महाबलाः ।आदाय तानि रत्नानि स्वां पुरीं पुनरागताः ।। ७.३९.११ ॥
transliteration: bharato lakṣmaṇaścaiva śatrughnaśca mahābalāḥ ।ādāya tāni ratnāni svāṁ purīṁ punarāgatāḥ ।। 7.39.11 ॥

translations.english: Bharata, Lakshmana, and the mighty Shatrughna, having received those treasures, then returned to their own city.
